summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Horizon Expansion Leaders ETF (EXPN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund seeks capital appreciation through an actively managed portfolio of equity securities issued primarily by US large-cap issuers. It also utilizes an option overlay strategy, selling FLEX or OTC options on commodity-linked securities. EXPN was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by Horizon.
